content.text: You’ve built a digital product. Ebook. Course. Template. Beats. But in the Philippines, Stripe and PayPal reject you. Conventional platforms lock you out. Your audience cannot pay. Your product cannot ship. This is not a temporary glitch. It’s structural. Local alternatives fail under load. You need infrastructure that doesn’t depend on permission. Google Apps Script is that infrastructure. It’s free. It’s serverless. It’s global. Combined with GitHub Pages for hosting, NOWPayments for crypto payments, and Google Sheets for order storage, it becomes a sovereign commerce stack. No platform owns your data. No subscription locks you in. You deploy. You own. This post explains how.
What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Google apps

Google Apps Script is a JavaScript platform that runs on Google’s infrastructure. It connects Google Workspace tools like Sheets, Drive, and Gmail. For digital commerce, it automates order processing, payment verification, and file delivery. It’s not a workaround. It’s base-layer infrastructure. When a customer pays in crypto, NOWPayments verifies the transaction on-chain. Apps Script checks the payment, logs the order in Google Sheets, and emails the product link via Gmail. No third-party platform touches your data. No monthly fees. No KYC. The customer pays in USDT on BSC. The fee is under $0.10. The product ships instantly. You own the entire pipeline. This is sovereignty. Not renting. Owning.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The stack has four layers. First, GitHub Pages hosts your product page. Free. Global. Second, NOWPayments handles crypto payments. 300+ currencies. 0.5% fee. No buyer account required. Third, Google Apps Script processes orders. It reads NOWPayments webhooks, verifies payments, and updates Google Sheets. Fourth, Google Drive stores your product files. Apps Script generates download links and emails them via Gmail. The pipeline is linear. Payment → Verification → Storage → Delivery. No single point of failure. No dependency on external APIs. Cloudflare Workers can replace Apps Script for higher load. Supabase can replace Sheets for structured data. But for 90% of creators, this stack is enough. It’s simple. It’s fast. It’s yours.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This stack is for digital creators in regions where global payment platforms are absent or hostile. Philippines. Zimbabwe. Venezuela. Pakistan. You sell digital products but cannot collect payment. Your audience has crypto but no credit cards. This stack solves that. It’s not a temporary fix. It’s permanent infrastructure. You deploy it once. It runs forever. No platform can shut it down. No currency collapse can stop it. Your customers pay in stablecoins. Your revenue is global. Your data is yours. This is not a compromise. It’s an upgrade. You chose better architecture. You built for sovereignty.
Sovereign commerce stacks give you infrastructure ownership, not platform dependence.
The Components That Make It Work Together

GitHub Pages hosts your storefront. Free. Fast. Global. NOWPayments handles crypto payments. Automatic webhook fires on confirmation. Google Apps Script processes orders. It’s the backend logic. Google Sheets stores orders. Simple. Reliable. Google Drive stores product files. Apps Script generates shareable links. Gmail sends delivery emails. Resend can replace Gmail for higher volume. Cloudflare R2 can replace Drive for lower costs. But the core remains the same. Each component is free or low-cost. Each is globally accessible. Together, they form a sovereign commerce stack. No platform owns any part of it. No subscription locks you in. You deploy. You own.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start with the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97). It deploys in 48 hours. GitHub Pages hosts your storefront. Google Apps Script handles backend logic. NOWPayments processes crypto payments. Three products loaded. 30-day support. Or build it yourself. Step one: Set up GitHub Pages. Step two: Integrate NOWPayments. Step three: Write Apps Script to process webhooks. Step four: Store orders in Google Sheets. Step five: Deliver files via Google Drive. Test end-to-end. Deploy. Own. The blueprint is available in The Sovereign Blueprint ($47). Full source code. Scaling playbook. No platform dependence. No subscriptions. Lifetime access. This is not a tutorial. It’s infrastructure. Built for the people Stripe locked out.

1. Set up GitHub Pages for your storefront. Free. Global. 2. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payments. 300+ currencies. 0.5% fee. 3. Write Google Apps Script to process NOWPayments webhooks. Verify payments. Update Google Sheets. 4. Store product files in Google Drive. Generate shareable links. 5. Use Gmail or Resend to send delivery emails. 6. Test end-to-end. Payment → Verification → Storage → Delivery. 7. Deploy. Own. No platform dependence. No subscriptions. Lifetime access.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not a developer?

Yes. The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) deploys in 48 hours. No coding required. Includes GitHub Pages hosting, Google Apps Script backend, NOWPayments integration, and three products loaded. 30-day support.
What cryptocurrencies can my customers use?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Recommended networks for low fees: BSC, Solana, TRON. Under $0.10 per transaction. No buyer account required.
Do I need to pay monthly fees for this stack?
No. GitHub Pages, Google Apps Script, and Google Sheets are free. NOWPayments charges 0.5% per transaction. No subscriptions. No hidden fees.
Can I scale this stack for higher volume?
Yes. Replace Google Apps Script with Cloudflare Workers. Replace Google Sheets with Supabase. Replace Google Drive with Cloudflare R2. The blueprint is in The Sovereign Blueprint ($47).
What happens if Google shuts down Apps Script?
Your stack keeps running until they do. But you own the source code. Migrate to Cloudflare Workers or any other serverless platform. No platform dependence. No lock-in.
